sources.snippet: 🍰 Tiny AutoEncoder for Stable Diffusion (XL) TAESDXL is very tiny autoencoder which uses the same "latent API" as SDXL-VAE. TAESDXL is useful for real-time previewing of the SDXL generation process. This repo contains .safetensors versions of the TAESDXL weights. For SD1.x / SD2.x, use TAESD instead (the SD and SDXL VAEs are incompatible). Using in 🧨 diffusers
